title: Luma Uni-1.1 vs GPT Image 2.6: Quality (2026)
summary: Luma Uni-1.1 vs GPT Image 2.6: five same-prompt tests in Flick, from a portrait and a poster to a storyboard and a character sheet, plus prices. Try both.
body_markdown:
### Is Luma Uni-1.1 better than GPT Image 2.6?


Neither won outright in our five tests. Both spelled every quoted word correctly; GPT Image 2.6 followed layouts and props more closely and costs less, while Luma Uni-1.1 gave a darker, more filmic look and larger images.


### Which is cheaper, Luma Uni-1.1 or GPT Image 2.6?


GPT Image 2.6, at default settings in Flick: 5 credits an image against 10 for Luma Uni-1.1 at Standard. Luma Uni-1.1 also adds 1 credit for each reference image, which GPT Image 2.6 does not.


### Which is faster, Luma Uni-1.1 or GPT Image 2.6?


Flick's model picker estimates about 30 seconds for Luma Uni-1.1 and about 2 minutes for GPT Image 2.6. We did not time our own runs.


### Can both models put text in an image?


Yes. In our poster and storyboard tests both wrote every quoted title, tagline, name and label correctly. Luma Uni-1.1 changed hyphens into long dashes, and GPT Image 2.6 added a restaurant name the prompt did not ask for.


### How many reference images do Luma Uni-1.1 and GPT Image 2.6 take?


Luma Uni-1.1 takes up to 9 reference images on Flick's image node, and GPT Image 2.6 up to 10. In both you connect them to the node and can @-mention them in the prompt.


### Can I use Luma Uni-1.1 and GPT Image 2.6 for free?


Both are on Flick's Free plan, and each image uses credits. Flick gives you 100 credits when you sign up and 200 more for joining the Flick Discord.
